messages:
maria: Heads-up — billing reports surfaced where the primary model (primary-v2) is getting charged even though the fncall validation rejected and we routed to the fallback. Console shows cost attributed to dispatched route, not the one that actually served token output.

aj: Ugh. Do we have an example event? my hunch: billing is recorded at dispatch time, before the validator rejects and trigger fallback.

maria: Example snippet from our logs (sanitized):
```
INVOKE_LOG ts=2026-02-15T12:03:21Z pid=4123 route=primary-v2 dispatched=true validation=failed fallback_route=primary-v1-fallback selected=primary-v1-fallback tokens=312 cost_usd=0.24
TELEMETRY_EVENT {route_id: \"primary-v2\", event: \"billing_recorded\", amount: 0.24, billing_phase: \"dispatch\"}
```
Notice billing_event.route_id == dispatched route, not selected one.

jamal: That matches what I saw. Our invoke telemetry currently sends a single \"route_id\" field at dispatch and downstream billing pipeline uses that. We never attach the eventual selected_route after validation/fallback.

aj: Two options: 1) attribute billing at accept/commit time (when validator returns) or 2) augment invoke_telemetry with a post-handoff patch that emits an update with selected_route/billing_anchor. Option 1 is conceptually cleaner but risks race/edge cases with streaming.

sophie: Minimal path: add a new field to invoke_telemetry proto: \"selected_route\" (optional string) and an enum \"billing_anchor\" { DISPATCH, ACCEPT }. Default for retrocompat is DISPATCH so nothing breaks. Patch billing pipeline to prefer selected_route if present.

maria: Agree on minimal: add selected_route + billing_anchor. We should also add a console dashboard guard to surface mismatches where billing_anchor==DISPATCH but validation_result!=accepted. Metric name: route_attribution_mismatch_rate. This will help monitor regressions during rollout.

aj: I'll prototype the proto change and small transform in billing service. Rough proto snippet: 
```proto
message InvokeTelemetry {
  string route_id = 1; // dispatched
  optional string selected_route = 12; // set when the final route is known
  enum BillingAnchor { DISPATCH = 0; ACCEPT = 1; }
  BillingAnchor billing_anchor = 13;
  // ...other fields...
}
```
Plan: ship server-side to always emit selected_route when available. Mark billing pipeline to prefer selected_route if present.

jamal: Important: for legacy events without selected_route, keep current behavior. We'll need a one-off backfill for last 7 days for invoices if we want exact re-attribution, but that may be heavy. Suggest we only surface mismatch metric first and re-run backfills only if material.

telemetry-bot: CI: proto change tests passed in CI (unit + lint), integration pending. :white_check_mark:

maria: Rollout plan: canary 5% on eng-platform sandbox -> 25% next day -> full. Add dashboard chart and alert (P3) for route_attribution_mismatch_rate > 0.1% over 1h. Also add a short note in runbook for billing team.

aj: Action items: 1) PR for proto change + server emit (aj) 2) Billing pipeline change to prefer selected_route (jamal) 3) Dashboard + alert (maria) 4) Canary + smoke tests (sophie) 5) Decide backfill after 72h of mismatch telemetry (team). I'll open a PR in ~30m.

maria: Thanks — please tag @billing-team in PR description and include a sample of mismatched events for them to eyeball.

sophie: I'll add a tiny e2e that simulates validator reject -> fallback to ensure billing attr flows through.

jamal: If anyone needs reproducer logs: run `./dev/run_invoke_repro --route primary-v2 --force-validate-fail` and check /tmp/invoke_debug.json.

maria: Great, keeping this thread for rollout notes. :thumbsup:
